items.rationale: The failed indoor supply pipe is assessed under §2.4.3(a), and §7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like repair materials. Comparable gross allowances of €42 for the pipe, €24 for sealant and €22 for insulation total €88 for the single flat-rate line.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary labour for the necessary repair. The invoice gives one flat-rate unit and no hour count, so the supplied €76 per-unit prior is applied once.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, regardless of the number of visits. The single charge is estimated at €81 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and allow one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. One flat rate at the supplied prior is €439 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the affected wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the affected patch, not undamaged surfaces. The single reinstatement line is estimated at €453 gross using the supplied prior.
